summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on cipher-box PR #296, then fix a series of CI failures and E2E test reliability issues that emerged after the PR was merged.
summary.outcome: All review threads resolved across multiple review passes; CI build fixed by adding missing package build steps to workflows; E2E test root cause identified (__ZUSTAND_STORES not exposed in production builds) and fixed with a VITE_E2E flag; vault readiness polls replaced with UI waits; public key extraction moved from Zustand store to Settings page UI.

repo: The project uses release-please with independent per-package versioning; first release bumps all packages together but they diverge naturally after that.

release-please uses 'main' as the PR title suffix when multiple components are present because there's no single version — setting pull-request-title-pattern at the top level (not inside packages) fixes this.
__ZUSTAND_STORES is only exposed in import.meta.env.DEV, so E2E tests that poll Zustand state silently fail in CI production builds.
E2E workflows (e2e.yml, deploy-staging.yml, e2e-desktop.yml) only built @cipherbox/crypto before web/desktop builds, missing the new packages: core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk.

The isLoaded flag on FolderNode is not set in all code paths — SDK-created folders and root folder after vault init have valid keys but isLoaded may be false, making it unsafe as a registration guard.
FolderTree.clear() zeros all stored key buffers, meaning registerFolder must copy incoming buffers or callers' keys get zeroed on vault destroy.
The public key for sharing is displayed on the Settings page at .settings-pubkey-value, making Zustand store access unnecessary for sharing tests.
Conflict detection tests legitimately need accessToken and rootIpnsName which are not surfaced in the UI, so they require store access via VITE_E2E flag.

code.finding: Changed from import.meta.env.DEV guard to (import.meta.env.DEV || import.meta.env.VITE_E2E) for __ZUSTAND_STORES exposure, keeping it out of production deploys.
ensureFolderRegistered guard should only check for empty key material, not isLoaded — isLoaded isn't set in all code paths (SDK-created folders, root folder).
fileKey not cleared if exception occurs before the re-wrap try/catch — needs try/finally wrapping the entire post-upload section.
createFolder leaks plaintext folderKey/ipnsPrivateKey on failure — duplicate name check should be moved before key generation, with try/catch clearBytes on failure.
registerFolder stores caller-owned key buffers directly; destroy() calls FolderTree.clear() which zeros them, so defensive copies are required.
Test 3.7 had 240s timeout that was raised to 360s, but the real fix was removing the waitForFunction __ZUSTAND_STORES vault poll and replacing with UI wait.
Vault readiness poll used __ZUSTAND_STORES which doesn't exist in production builds — replaced with waiting for the file list UI element instead.
Public key extracted from Zustand store replaced with navigation to /settings and reading .settings-pubkey-value text content.
Added VITE_E2E: 'true' env var to web build step so __ZUSTAND_STORES is exposed in CI E2E builds but not production.

workflow: When a PR is already merged, always create a new fix branch from main and make a new PR — do not push to the merged branch.

release-please PR titles showing 'chore: release main' indicate the pull-request-title-pattern uses ${version} at package level but needs to be set at root level without ${version} for multi-component repos.
VITE_* env vars are baked into Vite builds at compile time and tree-shaken when not set — safe way to enable test-only features in CI without exposing them in production.
In serial E2E test suites, early test failures cause all subsequent tests to be skipped, masking downstream failures that share the same root cause.
Outside-diff-range review comments in GitHub are not surfaced as review threads — must fetch the review body directly to see them.

friction: CI fix was committed and pushed to an already-merged branch, requiring the work to be redone on a fresh branch.
Test 3.7 failures required multiple retries before the root cause (__ZUSTAND_STORES in production builds) was identified — the symptom (360s timeout) obscured the real issue.
The isLoaded guard added for a Copilot review comment immediately caused E2E failures (upload failing with 'Folder not loaded'), requiring a follow-up PR to revert the guard.
orval codegen produced the same incorrect type for VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt even after regeneration, making that review comment unresolvable.
Fetching 'outside diff range' comments from GitHub requires fetching the full review body rather than review threads, which is a non-obvious API difference.
Background task notifications arrived mid-session requiring output file reads that were already resolved by the time they were read.
open_items: Conflict detection tests still rely on __ZUSTAND_STORES (via VITE_E2E) for accessToken and rootIpnsName — rootIpnsName is not surfaced in the UI so eliminating this dependency requires either adding a UI element or using page.evaluate with cookies.
web3auth-helpers.ts still uses __ZUSTAND_STORES for state injection — old test-login infrastructure not yet migrated.
recycle-bin.spec.ts uses __ZUSTAND_STORES__ (double underscore suffix) — not addressed in this session.
The VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt generated type is incorrect (orval codegen quirk with nullable Date types) — needs upstream orval fix or manual override.
Concurrent mutation safety for folder operations (Thread 2, PR #296) was marked not applicable — acknowledged as an architectural concern for a follow-up PR.

E2E test 3.7 (session restore after reload) remains sensitive to Sapphire Devnet latency on CI — the ZUSTAND_STORES fix should help but the underlying Core Kit session restore timing is not fully controlled.
